title: Broken rotor bar
line: Slip sidebands in an induction motor's stator current.
description: A broken rotor bar in a 4-pole, 60 Hz induction motor at 3% slip: sidebands at (1 - 2s)f and (1 + 2s)f in the stator current, measured against the supply line.
thumbnailAlt: Stator current spectrum around 60 Hz with sidebands from a broken rotor bar, rendered by RunMat
